title: Accounts Assistant
description:
The Company
Able Bridge Recruitment are thrilled to be working with an independent business which is part of a widder international engineering conglomerate in the recruitment of an accountants assistant on a 6 month contract.

Benefits include
Generous pension
Career development
Free on sight parking
Training

This vacancy, the result of a permanent employee being medically unwell, and will be office based in East Lothian for 6 months and will report into the finance manager.

The Responsibilities
The purpose of this role is to be accountable for the smooth and efficient running of the transactional elements of the accounting function. You will be responsible for liaising with internal stakeholders as well as dealing with suppliers in resolving queries.

On a day-to-day basis you can expect to be responsible for the following;
Processing and issuing sales invoices to group companies.
Processing purchase invoices accurately and efficiently.
Liaising with the procurement team and suppliers to resolve invoice queries
Assisting with supplier payment runs and ensuring invoices are paid on time.
Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the day-to-day activities of the finance team.

The Requirements
We are looking for an experienced accounts assistant (minimum of 3 years of experienced based in the UK), who is available immediately or at short notice. Our client is based in a rural location so a driver's licence and access to a vehicle is essential. Ideally candidates will have an accounting qualification, however candidates who are qualified by experience will be considered. Our client has a small and dedicated finance team and as such we are looking for individuals who are team players and who will roll their sleaves up in supporting the business in a widder context.

Our client does not hold a license to offer study support so will only consider applicants who are able to work unrestricted within the UK and who are based in the immediate vicinity.

If you are interested in hearing more detail about this role or would like to have a confidential chat about a potential career move, please do not hesitate in contacting me.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Could your eye for detail help strengthen financial controls and keep month-end running smoothly as an Accounts Assistant?

The Organisation

Join a growing Edinburgh-based company that values accuracy, integrity and strong working relationships. You will work in a supportive finance team with opportunities to develop your skills and progress your career.
- Support a growing organisation with a strong focus on long-term relationships.
- Work in an inclusive culture that values collaboration and personal growth.
- Contribute to a finance function that is improving processes and automation.
- Earn a competitive salary with ample room for progression within the business

The Role

As an Accounts Assistant, you will support accurate accounts payable and month-end processes. Your work will help the team produce reliable financial information and maintain effective controls.
- Process supplier invoices and employee expense claims, checking coding and approvals.
- Maintain supplier records and support supplier onboarding and amendments.
- Prepare payment runs, ledger allocations and related reconciliations.
- Post journals, accruals and other month-end accounting adjustments.
- Complete balance sheet, ledger and suspense account reconciliations.
- Respond to supplier and colleague queries and support finance projects.

The Ideal Candidate

You will be organised, analytical and confident working to deadlines. This role suits someone who enjoys solving problems, working with detail and collaborating across a business.

Mandatory
- Demonstrate previous experience in finance, accounts payable or financial control.
- Show experience supporting month-end activities and meeting reporting deadlines.
- Apply strong attention to detail, communication and problem-solving skills.

Preferred
- Understand invoice processing, payment workflows, journals and reconciliations.
- Use Excel confidently, with experience of Power Query, Copilot or Power BI.
- Show interest in working towards a relevant professional accounting qualification.

On Offer

The organisation supports hybrid working and will consider flexible working requests. The successful candidate will receive support with professional development and gain exposure to wider finance activity.
- Develop your career within a growing Edinburgh-based company.
- Work closely with colleagues across finance and the wider organisation.
- Gain exposure to process improvement, automation and business change.
- Receive support towards a relevant professional accounting qualification.
- Discuss flexible working arrangements during the recruitment process.

iMultiply is committed to diversity and will promote diversity for all employees, workers and applicants. iMultiply will treat everyone equally and will not discriminate on the grounds of an individual's 'protected characteristic'. If you like the look of this vacancy and think you could perform the role, but, you don't think you meet all the requirements, please DO APPLY for this opportunity. Data shows that certain groups, mainly women and people from Black and Minority communities, are less likely to apply for jobs where they don't meet 100% of role requirements. iMultiply would encourage you to apply for roles where there is room for development and growth."

title: Accounts Assistant

description:
Three Bridges Recruitment is delighted to be partnering with a highly respected and well-established Scottish law firm in Edinburgh to recruit an Accounts Assistant.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced legal finance professional to join a friendly and supportive finance team within a firm known for its collaborative culture and excellent staff retention.

Working closely with the Cashroom Supervisor and Finance Director, you will play an important role in the day-to-day running of the cashroom, ensuring accurate financial transactions, maintaining compliance and supporting the wider business.

Why Work Here?
- Salary up to £33,000 depending on experience
- Hybrid working with 2 days per week from home following probation
- Central Edinburgh location
- 25 days annual leave plus 8 public holidays, increasing with length of service
- Non-contributory life assurance from day one
- Critical illness cover after one year's service
- Support for professional qualifications and career development
- Join a well-established firm with excellent staff retention
- Friendly, collaborative and supportive finance team
- Varied role offering exposure to both legal cashiering and wider finance activities

About the Job?

The role of Accounts Assistant / Legal Cashier will give you the opportunity to be involved with the following:
- Managing day-to-day legal cashiering and cashroom activities
- Processing client and office account transactions, including receipts, payments and banking
- Preparing and processing electronic payments accurately and efficiently
- Completing daily and monthly client and office bank reconciliations
- Ensuring compliance with the Law Society of Scotland Accounts Rules
- Processing supplier invoices, disbursements and accounts payable transactions
- Maintaining accurate client and office ledger records
- Liaising with partners, solicitors and fee earners to resolve financial queries
- Supporting billing and credit control activities
- Assisting with month-end accounting procedures and reconciliations
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting audit and regulatory requirements
- Working closely with the wider finance team to ensure smooth and efficient cashroom operations

About You?

As a Accounts Assistant you will be experienced in the following:
- Previous experience working within a legal cashiering or legal finance environment is essential
- Good understanding of the Law Society of Scotland Accounts Rules
- Experience processing client and office account transactions
- Strong bank reconciliation and transactional accounting experience
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Confident working with financial systems and maintaining accurate accounting records
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build relationships with colleagues at all levels
- Proactive, reliable and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
- A positive and collaborative approach to your work
- Willingness to work full-time in the office during the initial three-month probationary period

At Three Bridges Recruitment, two of our values are "striving for brilliance" and "relatability". We want every applicant to receive an excellent experience and ensure that this role is right for you.

Should this role be of interest, please apply with your most up-to-date CV or contact us for a confidential discussion.

title: Credit Controller
company: Three Bridges Recruitment LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Location: Edinburgh (Central) - Flexible Hybrid (travel to Glasgow when required)

Salary: Up to £32,000 + Excellent Benefits

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

Three Bridges Recruitment are delighted to partner with a prominent, rapidly growing UK professional services and legal group to appoint a Credit Controller based in Edinburgh. Following a period of strategic merger and expansion, this newly created role offers an ambitious credit professional the chance to take real ownership of an Edinburgh-focused ledger. Working as part of a collaborative, Scotland-wide finance team, you will act as a trusted advisor to Partners and departmental leaders, playing an instrumental role in optimising cash collection and driving down DSO across high-value matters.

Why Work Here?
- Competitive Package: Salary up to £32,000, future performance related bonus, 7% employer pension contribution, private healthcare, and option to purchase additional annual leave.
- Edinburgh Focus with Hybrid Flexibility: A collaborative office base in central Edinburgh with flexible hybrid working (following an initial onboarding period) and occasional travel to Glasgow when required.
- Genuine Autonomy & Influence: Collaborative ledger reviews with partners where you are empowered to challenge senior stakeholders when appropriate, advise on risk, and set collection strategy.
- Expanding, Dynamic Brand: Be part of a forward-thinking group integrating established legal brands, offering genuine career development and long-term stability.

About The Role?

Reporting to the Credit Control Manager and working closely with local stakeholders in Edinburgh, you will take full charge of day-to-day credit management and working capital optimisation:
- Ledger Ownership: Manage an allocated debtor ledger across diverse, high-value client accounts, proactively securing timely cash collections.
- Partner Engagement: Conduct structured, regular ledger reviews directly with Partners and Senior Associates, establishing agreed action plans and tailored recovery strategies.
- Stakeholder & Client Relations: Act as a brand ambassador, navigating sensitive or complex discussions with clients and tailoring your approach to preserve long-term commercial relationships.
- Query & Dispute Resolution: Investigate billing discrepancies and legacy aged-debt matters end-to-end, liaising with internal legal teams to unblock payments.
- DSO & Performance Management: Track and report on key credit metrics, contributing to ambitious group targets to reduce debtor days and mitigate bad debt risk.
- Process Improvement: Actively identify efficiencies across systems, billing flows, and collection processes within an integrating business.

About You?

We are looking for a commercially minded, resilient credit professional with a strong personality who can combine ledger competence with strong interpersonal skills:
- Experience: Proven track record in credit control, collections, or accounts receivable. Experience within legal, accountancy, or wider professional services is advantageous, though strong commercial B2 B backgrounds are welcomed.
- Communication & Backbone: Confident dealing with senior stakeholders and Partners; comfortable challenging constructively, negotiating tactfully, and holding firm on credit policy.
- Analytical & Organised: Skilled in ledger reconciliations, dispute resolution, and managing multi-matter billing structures with high attention to detail.
- Adaptable Approach: Ability to adjust communication style across diverse client sectors and handle sensitive accounts with discretion and diplomacy.

Apply

At Three Bridges Recruitment, two of our core values are "striving for brilliance" and "relatability." We want every applicant to have an excellent experience and ensure this opportunity genuinely aligns with your personal and professional ambitions.

If this role sounds like the right next step in your career, please apply with your CV or contact Ryan Strachan at Three Bridges Recruitment for a confidential discussion.
